description: Postos de Carregamento Mobi E is a dataset listed in data.gov.pt, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Município de Lisboa. Serviço de mapa relativo aos "Postos de carregamento Mobi.E" em Lisboa Map service of "Electric Mobi.e Points" in Lisbon. Coverage: Município de Lisboa. The publisher named on the listing is Município de Lisboa. Its keywords include mobility, transportation, poi, opendata, dados-cm-lisboa-pt, transportes. The listing shows 1 download or service links in GEOJSON. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://www.opendefinition.org/licenses/cc-zero). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-dados-gov-pt.
